summary: A robot at a Tesla factory in Texas reportedly pinned an engineer and clawed at his back and arm during a malfunction, leaving an open wound on his hand. A colleague hit the emergency stop. Reports also raise concerns that injuries at the plant are underreported.
technical_summary: An industrial robot designed to grab and move freshly cast aluminum parts malfunctioned while an engineer programmed nearby disabled robots. It pinned and injured the worker until an emergency stop was pressed. The exact failure mechanism was not reported.

summary: Facebook's automated Year in Review feature showed some users painful memories, such as a photo of a child who had died, under a cheerful banner. Facebook apologised and changed the wording.
technical_summary: An algorithm selected the most-engaged posts and photos as a user's year highlights and auto-inserted one under an upbeat caption. It could not tell happy engagement from grief, and users had no way to opt out of the prompt.

summary: A Thai government wallet app often failed to verify people's faces during sign-up for cash handout and co-pay programs. Many people, disproportionately older adults, had to queue at bank branches or ATMs to verify their identity.
technical_summary: The Paotang wallet app used face scanning matched against ID card photos for identity verification. Differences in lighting, hairstyle, glasses or card photo quality caused false rejections, forcing manual verification at Krungthai branches or ATMs.
notes: Excerpts are in Thai without word spaces, so all tags are inferred from the AIID description and the reports' general content.

summary: During a US Navy test in a California harbor, an unmanned vessel under tow reportedly received an unintended command, accelerated and capsized a support boat. The boat's captain was thrown into the water and recovered, and declined medical attention.
technical_summary: A towed autonomous surface vessel received an inadvertent command that started its engine, so it accelerated past and overturned the tow boat. Reports cite software failures and human error, including communication problems between onboard systems and external autonomy software. The command's origin was not disclosed.

summary: A US strike on a primary school in Minab, Iran, killed well over 100 people, mostly girls aged seven to 12. Reports say the building was on a target list from outdated data. The role of AI targeting tools is disputed.

The school was listed as a military site in a database not updated after its conversion. Reports attribute the failure to outdated data and human processes rather than a chatbot's selection.
